content: Therapeutic foods are specialized food products formulated to address specific therapeutic needs, often with a focus on nutritional purposes. Examples include: Ensure: A fortified milkshake-style drink primarily designed to meet the nutritional needs of elderly individuals. Fortisip: Another milkshake-style nutritional drink, similar in purpose and formulation to Ensure. TwoCal: A high-calorie nutritional supplement designed for individuals requiring concentrated energy and nutrients. Plumpy'Nut: A peanut-based therapeutic food specifically developed for emergency feeding of children suffering from severe malnutrition.
